conflicts.description: Maynard Webb's FY2022 Director Compensation row prints Fees $35,000, Stock Awards $374,903 and a Total of '$409 903' (a space where the thousands comma belongs; the raw HTML cell is '$409 903'). The components sum to $409,903, which is recorded as the total. Because no '409,903' appears anywhere in the filing (the 2022 DEF 14A is the only document in the accession; no PRE 14A or amendment was filed that year), the loader's amount check cannot match the total to the quote and reports this row as a blocking problem. Recording 0 or another value would pass the check but misstate his pay, so the misprint is left as the one open verification failure.

Colin Powell's last FY2022 RSU tranche: the 2022 proxy's footnote (1) says the 2021-02-01 RSUs vested on February 22, May 22, August 22 and November 22, 2021, but footnote (4) says the shares 'that would have vested on November 1, 2021 vested upon his death'. The date difference does not change any reported amount.
